_comment: Phase 6C Pass 1: Tryptic baseline for digestion efficiency. Tolerance tunable: [-10,10] for well-calibrated Orbitrap, [-20,20] for less calibrated data.
_recon_note: Values here are OVERRIDDEN AT RUNTIME. Pass 2 sets precursor_tol, fragment_tol, isotope_errors, database.fasta and the mods from what pass 1 measured; pass 1 sets fragment_tol, the mods, database.fasta and mzml_paths. They are written honestly here so the template cannot be misread as a record of what ran. The record of what ran is the effective-params.json written beside each search, and Sage's own results.json beside it. 2026-09-02: removed database.fragment_min_mz/fragment_max_mz, deleted from Sage config in v0.15; they were being silently ignored.
